title: Local dimension lower bound for a polynomial quotient
statement: Let k be a field, m,t natural numbers, f : Fin t → MvPolynomial (Fin m) k, and assume the quotient by the span of the range of f is nontrivial and t ≤ m. Then at every prime p of its spectrum, ((m - t : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ topologicalKrullDimAt p.

source.place: Algebra, Section 00S8, lines 35834--35849, the lower-bound argument at maximal ideals and the Jacobson argument in Lemma 00OT.

proof.text: For a prime p, apply the local polynomial quotient height-difference theorem to obtain finite natural heights d = ht(p) and d' = ht(p.comap), with local dimension ((m - d' + d : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞).
The generators have encard at most t. The Krull height bound gives d' ≤ d + t; with d' ≤ m, arithmetic yields m - t ≤ m - d' + d, and hence the required lower bound.

proof_origin.place: Algebra, Section 00S8, lines 35834--35849; local height-difference formulation from the stated polynomial quotient dimension theorem.
